steps.text: Open the **Messages** drawer from the top bar. **Feedback** sits beside **New Message** in every tab.

steps.assertion: The drawer closes and a native floating conversation opens
steps.text: The drawer closes and a floating conversation opens, like a chat. Odoo prepares a preview of the page you are on; it stays on your computer until you decide to send it.

steps.run: edit The desktop status is unclear after reload.
steps.text: Describe what you saw and what you expected, in your own words. One message is enough; the product team asks if it needs more.

steps.assertion: The page-details choice is explicit before sending
steps.text: **Page details** is ticked when the screen you are on gives useful context: the action, the record you can read, the company and the release, never the address, form values or passwords. Untick it when the page does not matter.

steps.assertion: The task chatter replaces the initial prompt
steps.text: Your message becomes a card for the product team, and the conversation turns into its chatter: answers and status changes appear here.

steps.assertion: Start another conversation without losing the saved card
steps.text: **New** starts another conversation. The card you just sent is kept.
**My feedback** lists every card you sent with its current status.

steps.assertion: Resume the saved card after returning to the draft
steps.text: Choose a card to reopen its conversation and reply.
steps.trigger: .o-usl-FeedbackPanel button:contains('The desktop status is unclear after reload.')

steps.assertion: The recent list preserves the saved feedback card
steps.text: Come back to **My feedback** at any time from the same drawer to see where each report stands.
steps.trigger: .o-usl-FeedbackPanel button:contains('The desktop status is unclear after reload.')
